subject: MLB Manager of the Year voting
query: how is mlb manager of the year voted
title: How is MLB Manager of the Year voted? 30 writers, 3 spots, 5-3-1
answer: MLB's Manager of the Year is voted on by 30 members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America in each league, two from each city. Each ranks three managers, worth 5, 3 and 1 points, before the postseason begins. The BBWAA created the award in 1983. The 2026 winners are announced Tuesday, Nov. 10.
body:
Because ballots are due before the playoffs, a manager's postseason run does not count. Writers in American League cities vote on the AL award and writers in National League cities on the NL award. A voter may not split a spot between two managers, and full ballots have been published online since 2012.

The 2026 finalists are Kevin Cash (Rays), Chad Tracy (Red Sox) and Will Venable (White Sox) in the American League, and Don Mattingly (Phillies), Pat Murphy (Brewers) and Walt Weiss (Braves) in the National League. Manager of the Year was the BBWAA's newest award until 2026, when the writers added Relief Pitcher of the Year.
in_the_news: The BBWAA announces the 2026 Manager of the Year winners on Nov. 10, 2026.
